title: Radioactivity
content: The radiations are emitted from the nucleus of the uranium atoms and are of three types; namely alpha, beta and gamma rays. This phenomenon is known as radioactivity.
e: Radioactivity: The radiations are emitted from the nucleus of the uranium atoms and are of three types; namely alpha, beta and gamma rays. This phenomenon is known as radioactivity. Nuclear changes happen in the nucleus, not in the electron cloud of chemistry.

title: Alpha decay
content: Alpha decay is a process in which an atomic nucleus emits an alpha particle (helium nucleus) and transforms (or decays) into a different atomic nucleus, with mass number reduces by four and atomic number reduces by two.
e: Alpha decay is a process in which an atomic nucleus emits an alpha particle (helium nucleus) and transforms (or decays) into a different atomic nucleus, with mass number reduces by four and atomic number reduces by two. Nuclear changes happen in the nucleus, not in the electron cloud of chemistry.

title: Beta-minus decay
content: Beta-minus decay is a process in which a neutron in an atomic nucleus changes to a proton with the emission of an electron and an antineutrino.
e: Beta-minus decay is a process in which a neutron in an atomic nucleus changes to a proton with the emission of an electron and an antineutrino. Beta-minus turns a neutron into a proton, an electron, and an antineutrino.

title: Beta-plus decay
content: Beta-plus decay is a process in which a proton in an atomic nucleus changes into a neutron with the emission of a positron and a neutrino.
e: Beta-plus decay is a process in which a proton in an atomic nucleus changes into a neutron with the emission of a positron and a neutrino. Nuclear changes happen in the nucleus, not in the electron cloud of chemistry.

title: Gamma decay
content: In gamma decay, the daughter nucleus resulting from alpha or beta decay is left in an excited state, and it can then decay to a lower energy state by emitting a gamma ray photon.
e: Gamma decay: In gamma decay, the daughter nucleus resulting from alpha or beta decay is left in an excited state, and it can then decay to a lower energy state by emitting a gamma ray photon. Gamma decay dumps excitation energy as a photon; Z and A stay put.

title: Activity
content: The rate of decay of a radioactive sample is called activity. It is the rate at which alpha particles, beta particles or gamma rays are emitted.
e: Activity: The rate of decay of a radioactive sample is called activity. It is the rate at which alpha particles, beta particles or gamma rays are emitted. Gamma decay dumps excitation energy as a photon; Z and A stay put.

title: Half-life
content: The half-life is defined as the time for half the atoms in a radioactive sample to decay.
e: Half-life: The half-life is defined as the time for half the atoms in a radioactive sample to decay. Half-life is the time for half the nuclei in the sample to decay; activity halves on the same clock.

title: Radioisotope
content: A radioisotope (radioactive isotope or radionuclide) is an atom with an unstable nucleus, which undergoes radioactive decay, resulting in the emission of alpha, beta, and gamma rays.
e: Radioisotope: A radioisotope (radioactive isotope or radionuclide) is an atom with an unstable nucleus, which undergoes radioactive decay, resulting in the emission of alpha, beta, and gamma rays. Nuclear changes happen in the nucleus, not in the electron cloud of chemistry.

title: Tracer
content: A tracer is a small amount of radioactive isotope introduced into a system in order to follow the behaviour of some components of that system.
e: Tracer: A tracer is a small amount of radioactive isotope introduced into a system in order to follow the behaviour of some components of that system. A tracer is a tiny radioisotope dose you follow through a body, pipe, or plant.

title: Radiotherapy
content: Treatment with radiation is known as radiotherapy.
e: Radiotherapy: Treatment with radiation is known as radiotherapy. Radiotherapy aims ionizing beams at tissue to kill or shrink diseased cells.

title: Radioactive dating
content: Radioactive dating is a technique for estimating the age of an object by measuring the amounts of various radioisotopes present in it.
e: Radioactive dating is a technique for estimating the age of an object by measuring the amounts of various radioisotopes present in it. Radioactivity is nuclear: an unstable nucleus emits alpha, beta, or gamma.

title: Carbon dating
content: Carbon dating is a technique for estimating the age of the remains of plants and animals by measuring the activity of carbon-14 presents in the remains.
e: Carbon dating is a technique for estimating the age of the remains of plants and animals by measuring the activity of carbon-14 presents in the remains. Carbon dating reads leftover carbon-14 activity in once-living remains.

title: Nuclear reaction
content: A nuclear reaction is a process in which a particle or a gamma radiation penetrate into a nucleus, and changes its configuration.
e: Nuclear reaction: A nuclear reaction is a process in which a particle or a gamma radiation penetrate into a nucleus, and changes its configuration. A nuclear reaction is a particle or gamma entering a nucleus and rearranging it.

title: Exothermic reaction
content: If the total mass before a nuclear reaction takes place is greater than the total mass after reaction, this mass defect is released as energy in a nuclear reaction according to Einstein's relation E = mc^2. This type of reaction is known as exothermic reaction.
e: Exothermic reaction: If the total mass before a nuclear reaction takes place is greater than the total mass after reaction, this mass defect is released as energy in a nuclear reaction according to Einstein's relation E = mc^2. This type of reaction is known as exothermic reaction. Exothermic nuclear reactions lose mass; that mass defect leaves as energy.

title: Endothermic reaction
content: If the total mass before a nuclear reaction takes place is less than the total mass after reaction, external energy must be provided for the reaction to take place. This type of reaction is known as endothermic reaction.
e: Endothermic reaction: If the total mass before a nuclear reaction takes place is less than the total mass after reaction, external energy must be provided for the reaction to take place. This type of reaction is known as endothermic reaction. A nuclear reaction is a particle or gamma entering a nucleus and rearranging it.

title: Nuclear fission
content: When a neutron strikes and penetrates a nucleus of uranium-235, the nucleus becomes highly unstable, and splits into two lighter nuclei, shooting out two or three neutrons as it does so. This splitting process is called fission, and the fragments are thrown apart as the energy is released.
e: Nuclear fission: When a neutron strikes and penetrates a nucleus of uranium-235, the nucleus becomes highly unstable, and splits into two lighter nuclei, shooting out two or three neutrons as it does so. This splitting process is called fission, and the fragments are thrown apart as the energy is released. A neutron is uncharged; fission starts when a neutron is absorbed by a heavy nucleus.

title: Chain reaction
content: If the neutrons emitted from a fission reaction go onto split other uranium-235 nuclei and so on, the result is a chain reaction with a huge and rapid release of energy.
e: Chain reaction: If the neutrons emitted from a fission reaction go onto split other uranium-235 nuclei and so on, the result is a chain reaction with a huge and rapid release of energy. A neutron is uncharged; fission starts when a neutron is absorbed by a heavy nucleus.

title: Nuclear reactor
content: Nuclear reactor is a device in which a fission chain reaction can be initiated, maintained, and controlled.
e: Nuclear reactor is a device in which a fission chain reaction can be initiated, maintained, and controlled. A chain reaction is when fission neutrons go on to split further fuel nuclei.

title: Fissionable nuclear fuel
content: Fissionable nuclear fuel is the material for fission reaction to take place.
e: Fissionable nuclear fuel is the material for fission reaction to take place. Fission splits a heavy nucleus after a neutron bite, throwing fragments and more neutrons.

title: Moderator
content: Moderator is a material to slow down fast neutrons released from a fission process.
e: Moderator is a material to slow down fast neutrons released from a fission process. Fission splits a heavy nucleus after a neutron bite, throwing fragments and more neutrons.

title: Coolant
content: Coolant is to extract the heat produced by fission fragments when they slow down and stop in the reactor material.
e: Coolant is to extract the heat produced by fission fragments when they slow down and stop in the reactor material. Coolant carries fission-fragment heat out of the core before the metal melts.

title: Control rods
content: Control rods are used to control the rate of reaction by raising or lowering them from the core.
e: Control rods are used to control the rate of reaction by raising or lowering them from the core. Control rods soak up neutrons; drop them in to quiet the pile, raise them to let it run.

title: Reactor vessel
content: Reactor vessel is to contain the reactor core, moderator, coolant and control rods. It is a pressurized steel vessel.
e: Reactor vessel is to contain the reactor core, moderator, coolant and control rods. It is a pressurized steel vessel. Control rods soak up neutrons; drop them in to quiet the pile, raise them to let it run.

title: Shielding
content: Shielding (or containment structure) is a protective barrier, usually a dense material. It reduces the passage of radiations from radioactive materials by absorbing them.
e: Shielding (or containment structure) is a protective barrier, usually a dense material. It reduces the passage of radiations from radioactive materials by absorbing them. Radioactivity is nuclear: an unstable nucleus emits alpha, beta, or gamma.

title: Radioactive waste
content: Materials which are radioactive, and for which there is no further use are called radioactive waste.
e: Radioactive waste: Materials which are radioactive, and for which there is no further use are called radioactive waste. Radioactive waste is leftover active material with no further use.

title: de Broglie wavelength
content: The wavelength associated with a moving particle (matter wave) is called de Broglie wavelength.
e: de Broglie wavelength: The wavelength associated with a moving particle (matter wave) is called de Broglie wavelength. de Broglie wavelength is h over momentum; every moving particle carries a wave.
